name: returning_customer_greeted_by_name
description: Returning customer says 'Hi, it's me again' and the AI should greet them by name, recognising them from conversation history loaded via the Load Customer Context node.

messages.text: My name is Sarah, can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet the returning customer by name 'Sarah'

notes: Tests whether the AI recognises a returning customer by name from Supabase conversation history. The Load Customer Context node should retrieve the prior interaction and the AI should address the customer as 'Sarah' in its reply.
